card.name: Citation spots just before 1800s-1900s years
card.fires_on: Spaces, quote marks and title words inside citations and dates, right before a page number or a year around 1900 is written. Seen in journal references, quotation credits and diary dates.

modes.label: Journal citation
modes.description: The space after a volume number and colon, just before page numbers.

modes.label: Quote source title
modes.description: Title words or opening quote marks in a credit line for an author from the late 1800s or early 1900s.

modes.label: Dated diary entry
modes.description: The space after a month name, before the day and a year around 1912.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about the late 1800s and early 1900s, such as Victorian, railway and anarchist, and away from Cold War words like Soviet and nuclear.
card.plain: It fires in old-style references and dates, where a year near 1900 is about to appear.
